'''Abdul Matin Chowdhury''' (1 May 1921 – 24 June 1981) was a Bangladeshi academic and physicist.<ref name=bpedia>{{cite book |last=Islam |first=Sirajul |year=2012 |chapter=Chowdhury, Abdul Matin |chapter-url=http://en.banglapedia.org/index.php?title=Chowdhury,_Abdul_Matin |editor1-last=Islam |editor1-first=Sirajul |editor1-link=Sirajul Islam |editor2-last=Murshed |editor2-first=Md Mahbub |title=Banglapedia: National Encyclopedia of Bangladesh |edition=Second |publisher=[[Asiatic Society of Bangladesh]]}}</ref> He served as the 15th vice-chancellor of the [[University of Dhaka]].

==Education==

Chowdhury passed the entrance examination from Arunchandra High School in [[Noakhali District]] in 1937 and intermediate from [[Dhaka College|Dhaka Intermediate College]] in 1939. He received his bachelor's and master's degrees in physics from the [[University of Dhaka]]. He obtained a Ph.D. in atmospheric physics from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1949. He completed Ph.D. for the second time in 1961.<ref name=bpedia/>

==Career==
Chowdhury started his career as a meteorologist in the Pakistan Meteorology Department. He then joined as a [[Reader (academic rank)|reader]] in the Physics Department of the University of Dhaka in 1950. He went on to become a professor in 1962 and the head of the department during 1962–1967. He served as a member of the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission during 1967–1970, chief scientist of the Ministry of Defence and the president's scientific advisor during 1970–1971.<ref name=bpedia/>

Chowdhury was a member of the selection committee for the Nobel Prize in Physics for Asian Region.<ref name=bpedia/>

In 1973, Chowdhury was appointed vice-chancellor of Dhaka University, where he served until 1975.<ref name=bpedia/>[[File:Grave of Abdul Matin Chowdhury (1921 – 1981) by the side of DU mosque, Ex VC of DU.jpg|thumb|Grave of Abdul Matin Chowdhury by the side of [[Dhaka University]] central mosque, Ex Vice-chancellor of Dhaka  University.|263x263px]]

==Personal life==
Chowdhury was married to [[Razia Matin]] (1925–2012).<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-232519 |title=Razia Matin no more |date=2012-05-03 |work=The Daily Star |language=en |access-date=2019-01-11}}</ref>
